# `scene.delete`: Delete object

Deletes an object, with its children unless recursive is false.

- Category: scene
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(subtree x log n); O(children x depth) when children move up
- Flags: undoable
- Also known as: remove, erase, delete object

Deletes an object. With `recursive: false` its children move to its parent and keep their world positions. Meshes no other object uses are freed. Undo restores everything.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `recursive` | `boolean` | `true` | Delete children too (default); otherwise they move up to the parent. |
| `target` | `string` | required | Object to delete (name, path or id). |

## Examples

```json
{"target":"crate/lid"}
```

Result: `deleted crate/lid (o:2) and 1 child`
